We make encoders and sensors robust enough to keep things running for decades.

Maximize your uptime

We measure motion

Leine Linde develops and manufactures customized encoders, sensors, and system electronics for industrial applications. Our products and solutions are mainly used for measuring speed or position and are known for their robustness, performance and reliability.

Leine Linde expands the 600 Series with new 14 and 15 mm blind hollow shafts

To meet increasing market demand, Leine Linde is adding 14 mm and 15 mm blind hollow shafts as standard options across the entire 600 Series – available for both incremental and absolute encoders.

ADS Uptime app – Version 2.1.0 now available

We are excited to announce the release of ADS Uptime App version 2.1.0, designed to enhance accessibility and improve data usability for our customers. This update ensures a better user experience and aligns with industry standards.

Strategic Integration: Farresa Electrónica to lead sales in Spain and Portugal

Farresa Electrónica S.A.U. has successfully acquired all shares of Leine & Linde LTN S.L. Effective immediately, Farresa Electrónica assumes full responsibility for all sales activities in Spain and Portugal.
